acceptance: Reproduce the 963bb20c governed retry exactly: the live incumbent is a SHA-named standalone command runtime at accepted dev ancestor 5877b644 with the required -B argv and command-root/runtime-SHA environment, but one historical supervisor-generated tracked task brief causes the default immutable incumbent capture to abort before baseline, config, signal, launch, or rollback.

Add an explicit fail-closed transaction boundary for provenance-verifiable historical task-brief residue on an immutable incumbent. Do not clean, reset, stash, checkout, edit, or otherwise mutate the incumbent root, and do not weaken the clean immutable candidate requirement.

Bind the exact incumbent PID/starttime/cwd/commit/tree/remote/config/environment plus every admitted residue path, regular-file inode metadata, current byte digest, historical generation provenance, and revalidation digest before authority is granted. Reject staged/index-flag drift, non-task-brief paths, symlinks, hard links, Git identity mismatch, unaccepted commits, arbitrary current bytes, and every post-capture race.

Preserve immutable candidate Git and launch-source identity, config CAS, restart-intent-before-TERM, exact process-generation signalling, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and -B launch, status-child bytecode absence, three fresh-loop gates, authoritative-shadow catch-up, queue/worker parity, provider baseline, and rollback identity/cleanup.

Add positive and negative tests that distinguish the explicitly bootstrapped incumbent from the clean candidate, retain the command-checkout task-brief prevention boundary, and commit a task-scoped evidence manifest before independent review.

Keep this task source-only: no live config edit, direct process signal, runtime promotion, candidate deletion, canonical state edit, scheduling change, or fleet-routing policy change. Any rollout retry remains a separately governed dispatch.
